title: FixtureMetadata v1
description: Describes one synthetic decoded-frame sequence used for repeatability and cross-platform conformance. Fixtures bypass platform video decoders so identical pixels reach every backend. Frame ordering, byte lengths, and checksums are verified against the referenced bytes by the Python reference validator. Unknown optional properties are tolerated so the contract can evolve within major version 1.

synthetic.description: Deliberately generated provenance. Only synthetic fixtures may be committed, so this can never be false in this repository.

preprocessing_contract_version.description: Version of the decoded-frame preprocessing contract these bytes were produced under.

pixel_format.description: Canonical decoded-frame format: packed, row-major, tightly packed 8-bit channels.

orientation.description: Upright with no orientation-dependent transform left to apply.

frames.description: Ordered frame descriptors. Missing indexes, duplicates, and timestamp regressions are reported by the reference validator.

generation.description: Optional provenance for how the fixture was produced. Contains no participant information.

timestamp_ns.description: Fixture timestamp, mapped one-to-one from the frame index.

path.description: Path to the packed RGB24 bytes, relative to the directory holding this metadata file.
